remarks:
This 3 bedroom, 1 bathroom home is move-in ready located in Allentown NY, Allegany County.

The house has been well-maintained with some modern updates throughout. The newly enclosed front porch adds a nice extra space perfect for enjoying your morning coffee or evenings gathered with friends and family. The bathroom has also been recently remodeled. The spacious living room, along with all 3 bedrooms and the bathroom, are located on the first floor making this a good option for easy first-floor living. There is also attic space for storage and a walkout basement with additional storage space. A new furnace was installed approximately 3 years old. Outside, the backyard is fenced-in and gives you a nice private area to enjoy.

One of the unique features of this property is the insulated and heated detached garage. It has a concrete floor, electric, a large parking area, and two electric door openers. The garage could be used for storing vehicles, as a workshop, workout space, or potential for entertaining. There is also an attached 1 car garage connected to the house.

The house is located about 10 minutes from Wellsville, 15 minutes from Belmont, 35 minutes from Olean, and about an hour and 50 minutes from Buffalo.
